items.brief: Thailand proposes $148,000 daily cap on certain stablecoin transfers
items.why: Draft rules would restrict stablecoin transfers to same-person accounts or wallets.

items.brief: DTCC plans tokenized stocks on Solana in 2027, but wallet rules may limit access
items.why: Signals major clearinghouse entering tokenized securities, with wallet restrictions a potential adoption barrier

items.brief: DTCC adds Solana to tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
